gaps.what: The 350 cells (about 88,000 km2) of Cliopatria's Almoravid shape in La Mancha, Extremadura, the Ebro fringe and Setubal have no gain event (the shape draws them from 1094) and are bridged out in 1149 at confidence 1
Loss of southern Morocco (Sous, Draa, Tafilalt with Sijilmasa) dated 1147 only as a bridge from the fall of Marrakesh (confidence 1)
End of the Almoravid occupation of Algiers (1104 is a bridge, confidence 1); the Algiers page is silent and its timeline lists the Almoravid Empire 1082-1151
Banu Ghaniya in Ifriqiya after 1188 (Yahya ibn Ishaq, driven out in 1226, died 1233-1237): no towns or years of control on the page
Provinces used for the second taifas of 1145-1147 are the researcher's reading; the Taifa page dates Granada to 1145 against the Banu Ghaniya and Abd al-Mu'min pages (Granada Almoravid to 1155)

problems: Only almoravid-dynasty was touched; idrisids, aghlabid-dynasty, hammadid-dynasty and zirid-dynasty are unchanged (verdict fix). The hammadid-dynasty /ledger/7 (1082 loss of the Oranais to the Almoravids) is now matched by the Almoravid 1082 gain with counterpart hammadid-dynasty; the Hammadid author still owns the keyframe/occupation findings on its side.

Disagreements with the reviewer: Lisbon (the Alfonso VI page dates the Almoravid taking of Lisbon, Sintra and Santarem to November 1094, so the 1094 shape was kept and the 1111 gain deleted instead of either offered fix); Granada kept Almoravid to 1155 on the Abd al-Mu'min page rather than to Yahya's death in 1148/49; the drop of 1139 held southern Morocco and the Algerian desert fringe as well as the Sahara. Details with pages in history/polities/_notes/af-02-c.md.

The Abd al-Mu'min page failed to load with a bare apostrophe in the URL and loaded at the percent-encoded URL (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abd_al-Mu%27min); no page is left unread. WebFetch returns model-made extractions, so quoted phrases may differ slightly from the live text; years and months are those reported. The Afonso I page has a footnote reading 15 May 1147 for Santarem against 15 March on the Santarem page (the latter followed).

There is no keyframe for 1185-1186 (the Balearic Islands are Almohad; an empty region would be a validator warning); renderers must treat the gap as no territory. Events 1185 (loss) and 1187 (gain) carry it.
Weaker evidence now in the dossier: three events at confidence 1 (Algiers occupation end 1104, southern Morocco 1147, the 1149 bridge of the Iberian fringe).

Consistency check run: for every year 1144-1187 each cell entering or leaving the shape lies inside a gain or loss region of an event of that year (resolved through the gazetteer). Pre-1139 Cliopatria steps that the first pass left unexplained (e.g. 1056, 1090, 1094, 1110) were not part of the findings and are unchanged.
